note.question: How do please customers and prevent wastage compare for replenishment and issuance policy for a perishable product with age-sensitive demand?
note.overview: An online retailer selling a perishable product can issue inventories of different remaining lifetimes in its preferred sequence. This creates a trade-off between customer satisfaction and outdating costs since customers want freshness, whereas the retailer desires units be sold within their lifetime. This paper studies this trade-off by considering a joint replenishment and issuance policy for a perishable product with a general lifetime.
